fields.description: Selene Beach Residences is a distinct coastal phase on Sobha Siniya Island, comprising apartments and three-bedroom duplex homes. Garden-level yards and upper-level balconies create different outdoor arrangements. The developer expressly identifies Tower C as furnished, so furnishing should be checked by tower and unit rather than assumed across the collection.

research.community: Selene Beach Residences · Sobha Siniya Island
overview: The duplex Type A plan places living space and one bedroom on the lower level, with two further bedrooms upstairs. Its balcony and yard form part of the printed outdoor-area accounting; that total is not equivalent to enclosed suite space alone.
research.locationNote: The developer locates Selene on Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Brochure golf/beach outlooks vary with building, floor and orientation.
research.priceLabel: Developer-advertised starting guide · subject to stock
research.priceNote: Sobha’s enquiry section advertises AED 1.59m subject to inventory availability. Property Finder retains an AED 1.1m launch reference and marks its developer catalogue sold out. The historical lower figure and current advertised guide do not prove a live allocatable unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 60% during construction and 40% on handover. The public aggregate does not specify a separate booking instalment, so none is added or inferred. Obtain a dated current schedule and complete fees from the selected seller/developer.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports December 2027, shown as Q4 2027. The retrieved official residential brochure does not confirm a contractual delivery date; verify the selected unit and applicable release.
